# umami_me (Data Source)

The user the provider is authenticated as.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "umami_me" "current" {}

output "automation_user_id" {
  value = data.umami_me.current.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) ID of the user.
- `is_admin` (Boolean) Whether the user is an Umami admin.
- `role` (String) Global role of the user: `admin`, `user` or `view-only`.
- `username` (String) Username of the user.
